# Personal Tech Radar

## What it is

Personal Tech Radar (https://news.cearl.cc) is a personal technology intelligence archive. It publishes small evidence-first daily briefs and keeps structured history for events, entities, source health, and long-running claims.

## Content model

- Daily briefs: https://news.cearl.cc/YYYY-MM-DD/
- Topics and tracked objects: https://news.cearl.cc/topics/
- Search: https://news.cearl.cc/search/
- RSS: https://news.cearl.cc/feed.xml

## Method

The pipeline watches tiered sources, records source health, extracts structured candidates, clusters them into events, links evidence to entities and claims, and renders a concise daily brief for push delivery.
